implementation.summary: assembleEnvelope projects F-6's seams into the wire envelope with no recomputation: frozen.promptOverride ?: buildPrompt(frozen, nodeIdResolver(...)), the resolver inverting payloadHierarchyRows badges exactly as MirrorPayloadTab's preview does so the prompt sent equals the prompt previewed. Crop geometry from cropWindow(...).srcOffset/.srcSize only, rounded once per span. Hierarchy collapses to if (platform == Android && status == Ready) hierarchy.rawDump else "", with hierarchyAvailable = hierarchyXml.isNotEmpty() - the Empty snapshot's rawDump == "" degrades a stale Ready verdict for free. A null encodeCrop sets cropPath = null for that annotation and contributes no HandoffImage without aborting. mintSessionId called exactly once; version echoed from the argument.

validations.note: (1) .dstSize/.scale in core/send/: two hits, BOTH KDoc prose warning against them, zero code references. (2) PAYLOAD_FORMAT_VERSION defined once at core/payload/PayloadEstimate.kt:24; the only other hit is a KDoc @param link - not an import, not a re-export.

troubleshooting.issue: PP-TD-1 regression pinned by a dedicated frozen test: it captures the DeviceRect actually passed to encodeCrop and compares it against an expectation derived purely from cropWindow(...).srcOffset/.srcSize, using a fixture where srcSize is ~702px and dstSize ~72px so a .dstSize/.scale regression cannot pass by coincidence.

INHERITED F-6 INCONSISTENCY, out of scope here but real: buildPrompt is reused unchanged, so its trailer always reads 'Attached: frame.png, N crops, hierarchy.xml' even when hierarchyAvailable == false. The envelope can therefore contradict its own prompt text on a hierarchy-less send (iOS, or Absent/Unavailable status).
troubleshooting.resolution: Flagged for Stage 5 / Stage 6 - not fixed in T-6

troubleshooting.issue: Not pinned by any test: EnvelopeDevice.id degrades a null/blank deviceId to T-4's existing UNKNOWN_DEVICE_ID rather than shipping an empty string on the wire. The constant is reused, not duplicated, and mintSessionId still owns its own degradation (still exactly one call). T-9 should confirm.

The node-id resolver runs off the snapshot regardless of platform, so a hypothetical iOS send with a snapshot could name nodes in the prompt while hierarchyXml is empty. Matches the preview's behaviour; AS-29 governs the XML field only. Unreachable today (iOS has no dumper).
troubleshooting.resolution: Documented; T-9 should not assume otherwise

troubleshooting.issue: DECLARED SIGNATURE DEVIATION from the backlog's abbreviated parameter list: assembleEnvelope additionally takes hierarchyStatus, platform and version (needed to satisfy TAC-1/TAC-5), and encodeCrop is curried to suspend (DeviceRect) -> ByteArray? rather than a raw CropEncoder, since assembly never touches ImageBitmap. T-9 binds it as { rect -> cropEncoder.encode(bitmap, rect) } and supplies PAYLOAD_FORMAT_VERSION from core/payload at the call site - the constant is still not importable from core/send.
troubleshooting.resolution: Documented inline in KDoc and here
